read.thesis: Teva's generics erosion (generic Revlimid, generics down 16%) is being offset by innovative growth; FY26 revenue guidance raised to $16.7-17.0B and gross margin path to 57-58% in 2027, but no supply-side capacity signals.

triggers.label: FY26 revenue guidance raised
triggers.quote: we are raising our full year revenue guidance range to $16.7 billion-$17 billion

triggers.label: AUSTEDO revenue up 21%
triggers.quote: AUSTEDO was up 21% globally at $751 million

triggers.label: Q4 AUSTEDO revenue to decline YoY
triggers.quote: we continue to expect revenue in Q4 2026 to be down year-over-year

guidance.quote: we are raising our full year revenue guidance range to $16.7 billion-$17 billion
AUSTEDO now expected at $2.55 billion-$2.65 billion
We continue to expect 2026 non-GAAP gross margin to be in the range of 54.5%-55.5%.
increasing our guidance for free cash flow to be in the range of $2.1 billion-$2.4 billion
we expect a further 180 basis points-220 basis points of improvement
We set out to achieve $800 million of sales by 2027. Well, I'm in a position to tell you today that we are going to do that in 2026
remain on clear path for the net debt to EBITDA 2x by the end of 2027
continue to maintain credible path to 30% operating margin by 2027

prior_guidance_check.quote: continue to maintain credible path to 30% operating margin by 2027

red_flags.label: Biosimilar litigation risk
red_flags.quote: litigation will come, and we'll deal with that as and when it comes

red_flags.label: AUSTEDO IRA exposure 2027
red_flags.quote: revenue in Q4 2026 to be down year-over-year due to expected changes in the purchasing patterns

evasions.quote: Without getting into guidance, consistent with our past practices, we'll provide guidance in 2027 next year.
Whether we'll give you any guidance on that, you'll have to wait and see.

evasions.topic: Biosimilar SIMPONI launch timing vs litigation
evasions.quote: We may or we may not launch, and that depends on a number of factors.
